title: Orchestrate dbt models
subtitle: Airflow chooses when; dbt defines what
description: dbt defines transformations and lineage; Airflow defines when and in what dependency order work runs. Datapass can render the DAG and optionally execute its educational DAG with real Airflow 3 on GitHub Actions without creating a second data store.

steps.title: Build the staging model
steps.concept: A dbt model is a SELECT with dependencies and a materialization. This foundation supports literal ref/source, not arbitrary Jinja.

check.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM silver.stg_orders

steps.title: Build the revenue model
steps.concept: ref resolves a registered model to an asset, and the root records lineage from the actual materialization.

check.sql: SELECT customer_id, revenue, orders FROM gold.fct_revenue ORDER BY customer_id
